To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AIN 93 is the best diet available for use in rodent studies.
AIN 93 purified diets are nutritionally adequate and safe for growth and reproduction of rats and mice, for maintenance of adult rats and mice, and for maintenance of adult mice.
The AIN 93 purified diets were developed as a replacement for the AIN 75A, AIN 70C and AIN 70A purified diets and the AIN 6A semipurified diet.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an improved formulation of the American Institute for Nutrition (AIN) rodent diet.
the effect of diet on the incidence of spontaneous tumors.
the development of a purified diet for laboratory rodents that will be useful for long term studies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AIN 93 is the diet of choice for most laboratory rodent studies.
the AIN 91-92 and AIN 92-G diets are not suitable for long term studies.
the AIN 91-92G diet is the diet of choice for the study of the effects of dietary constituents on the growth and development of laboratory rats.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the AIN 92G, 92M and 93G diets are suitable for use with laboratory animals for short term studies, and the AIN 96 diet is suitable for longer studies.
the new diets are nutritionally superior to AIN 76 diets.
the AIN 75A diet has been replaced by the new AIN 93 series diets, and the AIN 70 diet has been replaced in part by the AIN 90M diet.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to formulate a diet that is nutritionally complete and balanced, and that is also palatable to rodents.
the AIN 75A diet was not nutritionally complete and was not a good diet for long term studies with laboratory animals.
the AIN 92A diet is not suitable for the study of the effects of dietary fat on the development of cancer in the rat.
